tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs mkha' spyod lam bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badzra wā ra hi/ rgyal ba'i yum mchog rnal 'byor mar/ /gus btud nas ni de nyid kyi/ /sgrub thabs nyung gsal go bde ba/ /mkha' spyod lam bzang bri bar bya/ /de la 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rgyun gyi nyams len mdor bsdus ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid rdo rje 'chang gi rnam par gyur pa'i sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas chos tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /lan bdun/ skyabs yul rang la thim/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba las bsgral nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom par bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i spyi bor pad zla'i steng du rdor sems he ru ka sku mdog dkar po rdor dril 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum snyems ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i sku can du gyur pa'i thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ yig dkar po de las 'od 'phros ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs hūm̐ la thim/ bdag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs/ yab yum gyi sku gang sbyor mtshams nas phyir 'phros pa rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad rnag khrag dud khu'i rnam pas phyir thon/ shul thams cad bdud rtsis kheng bar gyur/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sa mā ya ma nu pā la ya/ badzra he ru ka twe no pa/ tiṣṭha ḍ-i ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/

sarba siddhimme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shri yaḥ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān badzra he ru ka mā me muñtsa/ he ru ko bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twa a hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan bdun/ thal mo sbyar la/ sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad bshags so/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rdor sems yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ nang mchod dngos sam med na bsam kyang rung la/ lag pa g.yas pa bstan te oṃ/ g.yon pa bstan te āḥ gnyis ka bstan te hūm̐/ mtheb mdzub sbyar/ de'i rgyab tu srin lag gnyis bsnol la mdzub mo gnyis kyis bzung / mthe chung gnyis rtse sbyar ba'i phyag rgya bstan te/ ha ho hriḥ zhes lan gsum brjod/ g.yon pa'i srin lag gis bdud rtsi len tshul myang tshul byas la oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas snying kha'i baṃ yig mchod par bsam/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i steng du drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa sku mdog dmar po cang te'u thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan can rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ thal mo sbyar la/ bla ma rin po ches bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lan gsum/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma 'od du zhu/ rang la thim pa'i rkyen gyis snying khar chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi nang zla steng baṃ yig sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ rang gi lus sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi nang du pad nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan bsnol ba'i steng du/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug thur brkyang dang / g.yon thod khrag steng du bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ phrag g.yon kha ṭwāṃ ga la ḍā dril 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa bsnam pa/ mi mgo skam po'i dbu rgyan dang /

do shal rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan brkyang g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyis 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi nu ma dang dpral ba nas mnan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i skur gyur/ snying kha'i baṃ yig sngags phreng las 'od 'phros/ snod kyi 'jig rten chos 'byung gzhal yas khang dang bcud kyi sems can rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur/ phaiṃ zhes dang / phyag g.yas g.yon gyi mdzub mo sbrel/ mtheb gung gnyis so sor rtse sbyar lhag ma 'bar ba ltar byas nas dpral ba'i dbyings su bskor zhing / slar yang rang gi snying kha'i baṃ yig las 'od 'phros pas 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang 'gro ba rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur pa rnams badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shuddha sarba dharma yo ga shuddho3haṃ/ zhes dang / phyag gnyis khu tshur thugs kar bsnol ba lan gsum/ rang gi lte/ snying kha/ dpral ba/ spyi gtsug yan lag rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ dmar sngo dkar ser ljang khu dud kha'i mdog rnams gsal bar gyur/ snying kha'i sa bon sngags phreng las 'od 'phros lus thams cad gang / nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlab par gyur/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra warṇa ni ye/ badzra bai ro tsa ni ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes nyer gcig la sogs pa dam bca' bzhin rgyun 'don dang / bsnyen pa'i tshe 'bum bzhi'am 'bru 'bum phyag len la mdzad/ bzlas pa rdzogs rjes/ rang gi snying kha'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs zla ba baṃ yig sngags phreng dang bcas lte bar babs te/ de'i chos 'byung gi mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil ba bde ba'i nyams dang ldan pa dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa g.yon bskor du 'khor ba rnams la sems gtad/

ces dang / rlung bum can bzung la yid bzlas ji ltar rigs pa byed/ phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bcug la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rang gi lte ba'i baṃ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu ste/ de yang gzugs med khams 'od zer sngon po'i rnam pas lus kyi stod kyi cha la thim/ gzugs khams 'od zer dmar po'i rnam pas lus kyi bar gyi cha la thim/ 'dod khams dkar po'i rnam pas lus kyi smad kyi cha la thim/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba chos 'byung nyis brtsegs la thim/ chos 'byung nyis brtsegs zla ba baṃ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa rim gyis 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gyur/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag rang skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i steng du/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hreṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ lag g.yon sdigs mdzub phyogs bcur bstan zhing bsrung ba bya ba ni/ oṃ sumbha ni zhes pas shar dang / sumbha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis steng / gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis byang / oṃ gṛhṇa pa ya nub dang / gṛhṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis 'og oṃ a na ya ho bha ga wān bingya rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis lho/ de bzhin du sngags gong mtshungs las shar lho nas bzung ste mtshams bzhir sdigs mdzub g.yas bskor du lan gcig bskor/ bdag dang snang ba'i dngos po thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku'i rnam pa/ oṃ gsum ma la gcig dang / brjod pa dang grags pa'i sgra thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rang bzhin/ hūm̐ sems kyi rnam parartog pa'i cho 'phrul thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin du rnam par dag go

/dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /mkha' spyod dbang mo 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyi/ /me tog gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thogs nas kyang / /rol mo sgra snyan glu dbyangs sogs brjod cing / /mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid par shog /lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / /des gsung tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te/ bden pa de yis lha mo de dag gis/ /bdag cag rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /rgyal kun yum gyur shes rab pha rol phyin/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal gdod nas spros dang bral/ /brtan g.yo'i dngos kun spro dngasdudamadzad ma/ /rje btsun mkha' spyod dbang mo'i bkra shis shog/ //ces sogs bkra shis kyis mtha' brten par bya'o/ /de rnams kyi sgo nas rje btsun mkha' spyod dbang mo'i sgrub thabs nyung gsal go bde bklag chog ma 'di yang lha lcam bde ldan sgrol ma'i rgyun gyi zhal 'dod du sgrub thabs nyung bsdus shig dgos zhes bskul ma gnang bar brten sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis mgyogs par sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 kun dga' blo gros/ rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs mkha' spyod lam bzang / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
